statement: Recent-graduate unemployment minus the all-worker rate >= 2.0 pp in any 2027 quarter (NY Fed College Labor Market; 2027 quarterly)
status_at_phase_end: Not resolvable at the timeline start. In the regional central bank's series, recent-graduate unemployment ran about 0.5-0.7 pp above the all-worker rate in mid/late 2022 (e.g. Sept 2022 ~4.0% vs ~3.4%), far below the 2.0 pp threshold. Values are from a later vintage of the data file; an in-window vintage was not retrievable.

items.summary: Bloc A regional central bank's recent-graduate series (ages 22-27, 3-month average, SA): Sept 2022 recent graduates 4.03% vs all workers 3.44% (gap ~0.6 pp); Q3 2022 monthly gaps 0.6-0.7 pp.
items.detail: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, 'The Labor Market for Recent College Graduates', unemployment data CSV, retrieved via Wayback Machine (verified via web_extract this run; the archived file returned contains data through Sept 2023, i.e. a 2023 vintage, so 2022 values may include later revisions). Q3 2022 posting date approximate (quarterly update, typically ~November). Oct-Dec 2022 rows were published only in early 2023 and are excluded under the as-of rule.
